camel_example: aliyun polardb DescribeDBProxyPerformance --region cn-hangzhou --Type tair --DBEndpointId 'pe-0000000000000000' --EndTime '2020-09-24T02:08Z' --DBClusterId 'pc-0000000000000000' --StartTime '2020-09-23T01:01Z' --DBNodeId 'pi-0000000000000000' --Key PolarProxy_CpuUsage --Interval 60
description_en: Queries the performance data of PolarProxy
description_zh: 查询PolarDB代理层（PolarProxy）的性能数据
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-db-proxy-performance --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --db-endpoint-id pe-0000000000000000 --interval 60 --type tair --key PolarProxy_CpuUsage --start-time 2020-09-23T01:01Z --end-time 2020-09-24T02:08Z --db-node-id pi-0000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBProxyPerformance

parameters.help_zh: 数据库代理连接地址ID。支持集群地址与自定义地址的查询，不支持主地址的查询。不传则默认查询集群地址
parameters.name: db_endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The interval at which performance data is collected. Valid values: 5, 30, 60, 600, 1800, 3600, 86400, in seconds
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: Special metric. Set the value to tair, which indicates the PolarTair architecture
parameters.help_zh: 特殊指标，目前仅支持tair（PolarTair架构）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The performance metrics that you want to query. Separate multiple indicators with commas (,). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141787.html
parameters.help_zh: 查询的性能指标，多个值间用英文逗号（,）分隔，详细参数请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141787.html
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node in the cluster. This parameter can be used to query the performance metrics of PolarProxy on different nodes. The following metrics are supported: PolarProxy_DBConns, PolarProxy_DBQps, and PolarProxy_DBActionOps
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例节点ID。用于查询Proxy在不同DB节点上的指标，支持指标为PolarProxy_DBConns、PolarProxy_DBQps、PolarProxy_DBActionOps
parameters.name: db_node_id

DBType.description_en: The type of the database engine

DBVersion.description_en: The version of the database engine

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 查询结束时间。格式：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）

MetricName.description_en: The name of the performance metric
MetricName.description_zh: 具体的性能指标度量名称

PerformanceItemValue.description_en: The list of the performance metrics

Timestamp.description_en: The time when the metric value was collected. This value is a timestamp in milliseconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 监控指标的具体时间点，格式为时间戳，单位为毫秒

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）
